title: QR Scan Check
description: Prevents quishing by showing where a scanned QR code really goes before anything opens: the registrable domain in bold against what is printed beside the code (the sticker-over-the-real-code trick, with a one-tap "Go to the printed site instead"), lookalike and brand-borrowing domains, short links followed through a pluggable resolver, app downloads, and for UPI codes the payee, a pre-filled amount and "scan to receive a refund" scams.
